'''''T-ST''''' was a [[Utility Tug/Legends|Utility Tug]] in use by a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[Unidentified Rebel outpost|outpost]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], within an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] simulation. During an Imperial [[Proton torpedo/Legends|torpedo]] [[Bombing of the Rebel outpost|attack]] by [[Alpha Squadron]] [[TIE/sa tactical bomber/Legends|TIE Bombers]], ''T-ST'' attempted to board one of the [[Class-A cargo container]]s along with fellow Utility Tug ''[[T-SP]]''. However, the [[Starship/Legends|ships]] were destroyed in the attack, along with the entire outpost.<ref name="TIE Fighter" />

The battle simulation was featured in the Imperial combat training simulator, where TIE Bomber [[TIE pilot|pilots]] could test their skills with the torpedo warhead. ''T-ST'' boasted a [[Hull/Legends|hull]] with a 5 [[RU/Legends|RU]] rating and a speed of 10 [[Megalight|MGLT]],<ref name="TIE Fighter /> and was crewed by a single [[Rebel pilot/Legends|pilot]].<ref name="Alliance" /> The ship had [[Color/Legends|gray]] plating and yellow-and-black stripes.<ref name="TIE Fighter" />

==Behind the scenes==
''T-ST'' first appeared in [[Star Wars: TIE Fighter (video game)|''Star Wars: TIE Fighter'']], a [[1994]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] developed by [[Totally Games]]. The ship is featured in the third combat chamber mission of the TIE Bomber, titled "Torpedo Run," during which a [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] of TIE Bombers is designated to attack a small Rebel outpost. The player could optionally inspect ''T-ST'' to achieve a bonus goal.<ref name="TIE Fighter" />
